---
title: "MAUI Blazor Hybrid — A Setup Guide"
---

A complete guide to setting up a .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid app with a class library and MudBlazor components.

## Prerequisites

- .NET 9 SDK (or later)
- MAUI workload installed (`dotnet workload install maui`)
- Xcode (for macOS/iOS development)
- Visual Studio Code with C# Dev Kit (optional)

Verify installation:

```bash
dotnet --version          # Should show 9.x.x
dotnet workload list      # Should show 'maui'
```

---

## Step 1: Create the Solution

```bash
# Create solution directory
mkdir MyMauiApp && cd MyMauiApp

# Create MAUI Blazor app
dotnet new maui-blazor -n MyMauiApp -f net9.0

# Create solution file
dotnet new sln -n MyMauiApp

# Add MAUI project to solution
dotnet sln add MyMauiApp/MyMauiApp.csproj
```

### Resulting Structure

```
MyMauiApp/
├── MyMauiApp.sln
└── MyMauiApp/
    ├── MyMauiApp.csproj
    ├── MauiProgram.cs
    ├── App.xaml(.cs)
    ├── MainPage.xaml(.cs)
    ├── Components/
    │   ├── _Imports.razor
    │   ├── Routes.razor
    │   ├── Layout/
    │   └── Pages/
    ├── wwwroot/
    ├── Platforms/
    └── Resources/
```

---

## Step 2: Create Class Library

```bash
# Create class library for shared logic
dotnet new classlib -n MyMauiApp.Core -f net9.0

# Add to solution
dotnet sln add MyMauiApp.Core/MyMauiApp.Core.csproj

# Reference from MAUI app
dotnet add MyMauiApp/MyMauiApp.csproj reference MyMauiApp.Core/MyMauiApp.Core.csproj

# Remove default Class1.cs
rm MyMauiApp.Core/Class1.cs
```

### Create a Service Interface

**`MyMauiApp.Core/IGreetingService.cs`**

```csharp
namespace MyMauiApp.Core;

public interface IGreetingService
{
    string GetGreeting(string name);
    string GetTimeBasedGreeting(string name);
}
```

### Create the Implementation

**`MyMauiApp.Core/GreetingService.cs`**

```csharp
namespace MyMauiApp.Core;

public class GreetingService : IGreetingService
{
    public string GetGreeting(string name)
    {
        return $"Hello, {name}! Welcome to MAUI Blazor.";
    }

    public string GetTimeBasedGreeting(string name)
    {
        var hour = DateTime.Now.Hour;
        var timeGreeting = hour switch
        {
            >= 5 and < 12 => "Good morning",
            >= 12 and < 17 => "Good afternoon",
            >= 17 and < 21 => "Good evening",
            _ => "Good night"
        };

        return $"{timeGreeting}, {name}!";
    }
}
```

### Register Service in DI Container

**`MyMauiApp/MauiProgram.cs`**

```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using MyMauiApp.Core;

namespace MyMauiApp;

public static class MauiProgram
{
    public static MauiApp CreateMauiApp()
    {
        var builder = MauiApp.CreateBuilder();
        builder
            .UseMauiApp<App>()
            .ConfigureFonts(fonts =>
            {
                fonts.AddFont("OpenSans-Regular.ttf", "OpenSansRegular");
            });

        builder.Services.AddMauiBlazorWebView();

        // Register services from Core library
        builder.Services.AddSingleton<IGreetingService, GreetingService>();

#if DEBUG
        builder.Services.AddBlazorWebViewDeveloperTools();
        builder.Logging.AddDebug();
#endif

        return builder.Build();
    }
}
```

### Use Service in Blazor Component

**`MyMauiApp/Components/Pages/Home.razor`**

```razor
@page "/"
@using MyMauiApp.Core
@inject IGreetingService GreetingService

<h1>Hello, world!</h1>

<p>@GreetingService.GetTimeBasedGreeting("Developer")</p>
```

---

## Step 3: Add MudBlazor

### Install Package

```bash
cd MyMauiApp
dotnet add package MudBlazor
```

### Update `wwwroot/index.html`

Add CSS in `<head>`:

```html
<head>
    <!-- existing content... -->

    <!-- MudBlazor -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto:300,400,500,700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
    <link href="_content/MudBlazor/MudBlazor.min.css" rel="stylesheet" />
</head>
```

Add JS before `</body>`:

```html
    <script src="_framework/blazor.webview.js" autostart="false"></script>
    <script src="_content/MudBlazor/MudBlazor.min.js"></script>
</body>
```

### Register MudBlazor Services

**`MauiProgram.cs`**

```csharp
using MudBlazor.Services;

// Inside CreateMauiApp(), after AddMauiBlazorWebView():
builder.Services.AddMudServices();
```

### Add Global Using

**`Components/_Imports.razor`**

```razor
@using MudBlazor
```

### Add MudBlazor Providers

**`Components/Layout/MainLayout.razor`**

```razor
@inherits LayoutComponentBase

<MudThemeProvider />
<MudPopoverProvider />
<MudDialogProvider />
<MudSnackbarProvider />

<div class="page">
    <!-- existing layout content -->
</div>
```

### Use MudBlazor Components

**`Components/Pages/Home.razor`**

```razor
@page "/"
@using MyMauiApp.Core
@inject IGreetingService GreetingService

<MudText Typo="Typo.h3" GutterBottom="true">Hello, world!</MudText>

<MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="mb-4">
    @GreetingService.GetTimeBasedGreeting("Developer")
</MudText>

<MudPaper Class="pa-4" MaxWidth="400px">
    <MudTextField @bind-Value="userName"
                  Label="Your Name"
                  Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                  Placeholder="Enter your name" />

    <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled"
               Color="Color.Primary"
               Class="mt-3"
               OnClick="Greet">
        Greet Me!
    </MudButton>
</MudPaper>

@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(greetingMessage))
{
    <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Class="mt-4" MaxWidth="400px">
        @greetingMessage
    </MudAlert>
}

@code {
    private string userName = "";
    private string greetingMessage = "";

    private void Greet()
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userName))
        {
            greetingMessage = GreetingService.GetGreeting(userName);
        }
    }
}
```

## Step 4: Create Makefile

**`Makefile`** (at solution root)

```makefile
# MAUI Blazor App Makefile

PROJECT = MyMauiApp/MyMauiApp.csproj
FRAMEWORK = net9.0-maccatalyst
CONFIG_DEBUG = Debug
CONFIG_RELEASE = Release

.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

.PHONY: run
run: ## Run the app in Debug mode
	dotnet run -p $(PROJECT) -f $(FRAMEWORK) -c $(CONFIG_DEBUG)

.PHONY: build
build: ## Build the app in Debug mode
	dotnet build $(PROJECT) -f $(FRAMEWORK) -c $(CONFIG_DEBUG)

.PHONY: build-release
build-release: ## Build the app in Release mode
	dotnet build $(PROJECT) -f $(FRAMEWORK) -c $(CONFIG_RELEASE)

.PHONY: clean
clean: ## Clean build outputs
	dotnet clean
	rm -rf MyMauiApp/bin MyMauiApp/obj
	rm -rf MyMauiApp.Core/bin MyMauiApp.Core/obj

.PHONY: rebuild
rebuild: clean build ## Clean and rebuild

.PHONY: restore
restore: ## Restore NuGet packages
	dotnet restore

.PHONY: help
help: ## Show this help
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## .*$$' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*?## "}; {printf "  \033[36m%-15s\033[0m %s\n", $$1, $$2}'
```

---

## Step 5: Build and Run

### macOS (Mac Catalyst)

```bash
make run
# or
dotnet run -f net9.0-maccatalyst -c Debug
```

### iOS Simulator

```bash
dotnet build -f net9.0-ios -c Debug
# Then run from Xcode or VS Code
```

### Android

```bash
dotnet build -f net9.0-android -c Debug
# Requires Android SDK and emulator
```

## Common MudBlazor Components

| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `MudText` | Typography with Material Design styles |
| `MudButton` | Buttons with variants (Filled, Outlined, Text) |
| `MudTextField` | Text input with labels and validation |
| `MudPaper` | Card-like container with elevation |
| `MudAlert` | Alert/notification messages |
| `MudDialog` | Modal dialogs |
| `MudSnackbar` | Toast notifications |
| `MudTable` | Data tables with sorting/paging |
| `MudNavMenu` | Navigation menu |
| `MudAppBar` | Top app bar |

---

## DI Service Lifetimes

| Lifetime | Method | Use Case |
|----------|--------|----------|
| Singleton | `AddSingleton<T>()` | Shared state, caches, configuration |
| Scoped | `AddScoped<T>()` | Per-user/per-request state |
| Transient | `AddTransient<T>()` | Stateless services, lightweight operations |

For MAUI Blazor apps:
- Use **Singleton** for services shared across the app
- Use **Scoped** for per-page/component services
- Use **Transient** for stateless utilities

## Troubleshooting

### Xcode Version Mismatch

If you see an error like "requires Xcode XX.0":

```bash
# Check installed SDK versions
ls /usr/local/share/dotnet/sdk-manifests/9.0.100/microsoft.net.sdk.maccatalyst/

# Remove preview SDK if present
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/share/dotnet/sdk-manifests/9.0.100/microsoft.net.sdk.maccatalyst/[preview-version]
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/share/dotnet/packs/Microsoft.MacCatalyst.Sdk.net9.0_[preview-version]

# Repair workloads
dotnet workload repair
```

### Hot Reload Not Working

Hot Reload is experimental for MAUI. For best results:
- Use `dotnet watch` for code changes
- Restart the app for XAML/layout changes

### MudBlazor Styles Not Loading

Ensure the CSS is loaded in correct order:
1. Bootstrap (if keeping it)
2. app.css
3. MudBlazor.min.css (last, so it can override)
